dtc.interpretation: Synthetic conditional scenario exploration and implementation checks only; no empirical chain validation, calibrated default probability or reconstruction of DTC controls.
dtc.queue_policy: One participant, positive indivisible outgoing obligations, strict FIFO; blocked head prevents bypass. Resource events at a timestamp precede transaction arrivals.
dtc.cash_accounting: Cash first repays simulated outstanding debit; excess is prefunding. Outgoing payments spend prefunding before adding debit. Cash is never also credited to the eligible collateral portfolio.
dtc.cap_accounting: An increased debit cap is capacity only, not money and not collateral. Actual funding requires a separate cash event.
dtc.collateral_accounting: Separate exogenously valued eligible portfolio = market value*(1-haircut); incoming purchased securities are not automatically added. Revaluation can create an existing exposure breach without reversing completed settlements.
dtc.baseline_funding: Total scheduled baseline cash funding equals gross generated payment amount; timing weights are arbitrary seeded Dirichlet draws, not inferred participant behavior.
dtc.pairing: Each replicate uses the same transactions and base funding draws across all scenarios. Funding/haircut/resource changes are declared interventions, not estimated causal effects.
dtc.censoring: EOD pending waits are right-censored; settled-wait statistics exclude pending obligations and are not overall completion-time estimates.
dtc.cash_rescue: Default rescue deliberately supplies cash equal to gross payments as a sufficient-liquidity control, not an operational recommendation.
dtc.parameters: All hypothetical constants and distributions are scenario assumptions, not DTCC limits or estimated risk parameters.

epn.mechanism: Instant initial syntax precheck, FIFO valid-notice processor with pausing outage, pool availability gate, fixed delivery lag.
epn.time_basis: Hypothetical relative minutes; not official SIFMA/EPN operating cutoffs.
epn.units: Order notional in USD million; work/capacity are hypothetical orders per simulation minute.
epn.coupling: Common latent arrivals, pool-ready times, correction times, error draws and notionals across scenarios within a replicate.
epn.late_notice_scope: Late valid notification is reported separately; it is not automatically a failed delivery.
epn.horizon_scope: Delayed completed deliveries and not completed by horizon are separate; delay for unfinished orders is a lower bound.
epn.capacity_scope: Each scenario uses its specified fixed capacity for the entire simulated day, including before and after an outage. The higher-capacity case is not a capacity change activated only at recovery.
epn.waiting_scope: queue_start_min is the nominal eligible/service-start time before any outage suspension. processing_wait_min measures waiting before that nominal start and excludes pauses during processing. Delivery deadline and horizon delay metrics capture the end-to-end effect of outages.
epn.identification_limit: Assumed conditional queue mechanism only, not real EPN outage exposure, failure probabilities or empirical chain validation.

tba.units: USD gross unsettled notional; USD-days for integrated stocks; simulated days, not calendar dates
tba.interpretation: Conditional stock-flow scenario only, not empirical DTCC transmission validation, loss, cash obligation, margin call or calibrated failure probability.

reference.scope: Broad MBSD unsettled-guarantee notional, NOT identified TBA positions

tba.hypothetical_tba_share: 0.5 default, 0.25/0.75 sensitivities; never estimated from PQD
tba.new_flow_and_maturities: Entirely assumed; broad daily MBSD clearing notional is not used as TBA origination
tba.cancellations: Seeded requests proportional to initial stock, capped at available stock and allocated pro rata before settlement
tba.deferrals: Assumed completion fraction applies only to due/overdue buckets; deferred positions retain original maturity and remain outstanding
tba.recovery: Earlier recovery removes the assumed impairment sooner; no early settlement of future trades is used in experiment cases
tba.capacity_limit: There is no separate settlement-throughput cap. In an unimpaired day all due/overdue notionals settle, so recovery speed is a model assumption, not an observed MBSD capability.
tba.randomness: Same latent opening weights, AR(1) lognormal daily-flow multiplier, tenor choices and cancellation requests across paired cases; share cases scale the same draws
